# Bring the Bloom Bar and Rentals

> Bloom bar and flower bar rental service
based in La Habra, California, serving
Orange County and LA County border cities.

## What We Offer

### DIY Flower Bar Rental
- The Flower Bar — $49/day. Bloom bar stand
  only. Flowers not included.
- Boho Bloom Bundle — $84/day. Bloom bar
  stand plus boho umbrella. Flowers not
  included.
- Delivery: $14 for La Habra, plus $1.50
  per mile beyond La Habra.
- Setup and breakdown included. Delivery
  only — no pickup option.

### Full Bloom Bar Experience
- Classic Collection — $25/guest. 6-8 stems
  per guest. Carnations, Daisies,
  Alstroemeria, Fillers, Greenery.
- Signature Collection — $35/guest. 8-10
  stems per guest. Roses, Spray Roses,
  Premium Fillers, Greenery. Most popular.
- Luxury Collection — $45/guest. 10-12 stems
  per guest. Garden Roses, Lisianthus,
  Premium Fillers, Lush Greenery.
- 15 guest minimum applies to all full
  service bookings.
- Fresh flowers sourced within 48 hours of
  the event. Full setup and breakdown
  included.
- Delivery is a flat zone fee: $35 (0-5mi),
  $50 (5-10mi), $55 (10-15mi), $65 (15-30mi)
  from La Habra.
- 6 color palettes available: Blush & White,
  Garden Greens, Bold & Romantic, Something
  Blue, Spring Pastels, Jewel Tones. Classic
  Collection is limited to Blush & White,
  Garden Greens, and Spring Pastels.

## Service Area

### North Orange County / LA Border
La Habra, Fullerton, Brea, Anaheim,
Placentia, Yorba Linda, Orange, Hacienda
Heights, Chino Hills, Whittier

### Central & South Orange County
Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Irvine

### LA County Border
Cerritos

## Perfect For
Bridal showers, baby showers, birthday
parties, weddings, wedding receptions,
quinceañeras, corporate events, team
building events, engagement parties,
and backyard celebrations.

## Booking
A $100 deposit secures any booking date.
Book online at bringthebloombar.com/book
or contact us directly.

## Policies
Cancellations more than 14 days before the
event may receive a refund minus the deposit.
Cancellations within 14 days forfeit all
deposits. The renter is responsible for any
permits or venue approvals required for
their event.
